summary: Pre-alpha: tray, F1 overlay (detection, magnifier, colour picker, annotation, redaction; double-click or Enter pins), F3 paste, pins that zoom, resize, turn, flip, fade, shrink, pass clicks and group

commands.name: capabilities
commands.summary: This document

commands.name: version
commands.summary: Noeul's version and the contract, schema and IPC versions it speaks

commands.name: status
commands.summary: Whether Noeul runs, its pins, global hotkey registrations, desktop state and settings; starts nothing

commands.name: health
commands.summary: Checks that the running instance is Noeul of this user and answers; exit 0 only when healthy

commands.name: config.show
commands.summary: Effective settings and the stable per-user paths; reads files only

commands.name: config.set
commands.summary: Change one setting in config.toml in place (gestures.double_click pin|copy|save|none, gestures.middle_click, gestures.preset noeul|snipaste, capture.quick_save_folder, capture.keyboard_help, capture.detection window|element|off, capture.magnifier on|off, pins.border on|off, pins.shadow on|off, paste.paths on|off, paste.file_cards on|off, color.format hex|rgb|hsl, color.hex_case upper|lower, color.alpha on|off, general.tray_icon); the Snipaste-style preset also writes its overlay shortcuts; a running Noeul reloads

commands.name: config.reset
commands.summary: Reset one section or every setting to its default (gestures also undoes the preset's shortcuts); unknown keys and comments stay

commands.name: start
commands.summary: Start the resident instance detached (or hand over to the running one); it shows the optional tray icon and registers its global hotkeys

commands.name: run
commands.summary: Run the instance in this process until it quits (what start launches)

commands.name: quit
commands.summary: End the instance: release its hotkeys and close its pins (open pins need --yes)

commands.name: capture
commands.summary: The running instance captures a region, a whole monitor or the active window of the unlocked interactive desktop (optionally with the pointer) and pins it in place, reporting the monitor, the logical size and honest warnings (mixed scales, HDR converted to SDR, protected windows); opens the region selection overlay as F1 does (--interactive, a visible window), or cancels it (--cancel); desktop_unavailable otherwise; nothing is written to disk

commands.name: pin
commands.summary: The running instance reads the clipboard once (or the local image file) and pins what it holds as F3 does: an image, image files, a colour swatch, an HTML or text card; without taking focus, inside the monitor's work area (zoomed out when larger), announced by a notice; private clipboard content is refused; a dry run reads nothing

commands.name: pin.list
commands.summary: The open pins (IDs, geometry, zoom, orientation, opacity, thumbnail, click-through, group, visibility, on-screen state, annotation count, editing, animated GIF notice) and the reopenable one

commands.name: pin.hide
commands.summary: Hide pins without closing them; nothing takes focus

commands.name: pin.show
commands.summary: Show hidden pins again without taking focus; --on-screen also moves pins no monitor shows into the nearest work area

commands.name: pin.close
commands.summary: Close pins; only the last closed pin can be reopened

commands.name: pin.reopen
commands.summary: Reopen the last closed pin with its ID and position

commands.name: pin.set
commands.usage: noeul pin set (<id> | --group <name> | --all) [--at <x,y>] [--zoom <percent>] [--opacity <percent>] [--rotate cw|ccw] [--rotation 0|90|180|270] [--flip horizontal|vertical] [--mirrored on|off] [--thumbnail on|off] [--click-through on|off] [--move-to-group <name>] [--endpoint <name>] [--dry-run] [--json]
commands.summary: Change pins precisely: place one exactly, zoom, opacity (10-100 %), rotation and flips, thumbnail mode, click-through and group; every change is reversible and nothing takes focus

commands.name: pin.group.list
commands.summary: The pin groups with their pins and the current group

commands.name: pin.group.switch
commands.summary: Switch to a pin group (created when new): its pins show, every other pin hides, new pins go to it

commands.name: pin.restore
commands.summary: Restore the backed-up pins that are not open, with their place, zoom, turn, opacity, group and visibility; never duplicates, never captures, skips damaged pictures

commands.name: pin.backup.status
commands.summary: Whether the opt-in pin backup is on, when it was written, how many pins it holds and how many are not open (works without a running Noeul)

commands.name: pin.backup.save
commands.summary: Write the pin backup now (it is also written a second after the pins change, with [pins] backup on)

commands.name: pin.backup.clear
commands.summary: Remove the pin backup and its pictures; open pins stay open (works without a running Noeul)

commands.name: history.list
commands.summary: The kept captures: number, rectangle, time, how each ended and whether it is on disk (never pixels)

commands.name: history.pin
commands.summary: Pin a kept capture again where it was taken (default: the newest)

commands.name: history.forget
commands.summary: Forget one kept capture, in memory and on disk

commands.name: history.clear
commands.summary: Forget every kept capture, in memory and on disk (the disk history also without a running Noeul)

commands.name: settings
commands.summary: Open the running Noeul's settings window: every shortcut with its keys (record, disable, reset, reset all, import, export), the double-click and middle-click gestures, the tray icon, the disk history and the pin backup; each change runs the matching CLI command

commands.name: hotkeys.list
commands.summary: Noeul's shortcuts: every action with its keys, scope, source, state and registration

commands.name: hotkeys.show
commands.summary: One shortcut action with its bindings and every conflict that involves it

commands.name: hotkeys.set
commands.summary: Replace an action's bindings; a conflicting change is refused (hotkey_conflict) and nothing is written

commands.name: hotkeys.disable
commands.summary: Disable one shortcut, all of them or one scope

commands.name: hotkeys.enable
commands.summary: Turn all shortcuts or one scope back on

commands.name: hotkeys.reset
commands.summary: Restore an action's default, or discard every change (--all keeps a backup)

commands.name: hotkeys.check
commands.summary: Conflict report for Noeul's shortcuts; --all-tools reads every installed tool's hotkey files (starts nothing)

commands.name: hotkeys.export
commands.summary: Print Noeul's hotkeys.json user layer

commands.name: hotkeys.import
commands.summary: Validate a kim.hotkeys document and replace the user layer (keeps a backup)
